class.name: AbilityContainer
class.brief_description: A container node that manages granting, executing, tracking, and revoking gameplay abilities for an entity.
class.description: [AbilityContainer] serves as the runtime ability manager linked to a specific entity. It holds a list of granted [AbilityData] resources, evaluates activation constraints (such as checking tags, costs, and cooldowns), tracks ongoing ability cooldown timers, and provides virtual hook methods for custom logic when granting or executing abilities.

method.name: _can_activate
method.description: Virtual method called to evaluate whether the specified [param ability] can currently be activated. Can be overridden in scripts or inherited C++ classes to implement custom activation conditions.

method.name: _can_be_granted
method.description: Virtual method called to check whether the specified [param ability] is allowed to be added to this container. Override this method to implement custom grant requirements.

method.name: _on_ability_already_granted
method.description: Virtual method triggered when attempting to grant an [param ability] that is already present in this container. Override this to define duplicate ability behaviors (such as leveling up or ignoring duplicate grants).

method.name: clear
method.description: Revokes all currently granted abilities from this container and clears active state tracking.

method.name: get_cooldown
method.description: Returns the cooldown of the specified [param ability].

method.name: get_current_cooldown
method.description: Returns the remaining cooldown time in seconds for the specified [param ability]. Returns [code]0.0[/code] if the ability is off cooldown or not active.

method.name: grant_ability
method.description: Attempts to grant the specified [param ability] to this container. Returns [code]true[/code] if the ability was successfully granted, or [code]false[/code] if validation failed or the operation was rejected. Calls the ability_granted signal.

method.name: has_ability
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the specified [param ability] is currently granted to and present within this container.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the ability matching the specified [param id] is currently executing.

method.name: is_on_cooldown
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the ability is currently on cooldown.

method.name: revoke_ability
method.description: Ends the specified [param ability] if it's activa and removes it from this container. Returns [code]true[/code] if the ability was found and successfully removed.

method.name: set_entity_node_path
method.description: Sets the [NodePath] pointing to the target entity node. Returns [code]true[/code] if the path was valid and successfully updated.

method.name: try_activate
method.description: Attempts to activate the [param id] ability after validating resource costs, cooldowns, and tag constraints. Returns [code]true[/code] if activation succeeded.

method.name: try_activate_abilities_with_tags
method.description: Attempts to activate all granted abilities that match the provided gameplay ability tag [param ids]. Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one ability was successfully activated.

members.member: The collection of [AbilityData] resources currently granted to and usable by this container.
The [NodePath] pointing to the owning entity node (such as a [GAS_Entity]) that this container manages abilities for.

signal.name: abilities_cleared
signal.description: Emitted when all granted abilities are cleared from this container via [method clear].

signal.name: ability_activated
signal.description: Emitted when [param ability] is successfully activated for the specified target [param entity].

signal.name: ability_ended
signal.description: Emitted when [param ability] finishes execution or is cancelled for the specified target [param entity].

signal.name: ability_granted
signal.description: Emitted when [param ability] is successfully granted to this container for the specified target [param entity].

signal.name: ability_revoked
signal.description: Emitted when [param ability] is removed from this container for the specified target [param entity]. Using [method clear] does not emit this signal.
